gd: Halò, ciamar a tha thu?
en: Hello, how are you?

gd: Tha gu math, tapadh leat.
en: I'm fine, thank you.

gd: Is mise Iain.
en: I am Iain.

gd: Dè an t-ainm a th' ort?
en: What is your name?

gd: Tha mi a' fuireach ann an Glaschu.
en: I live in Glasgow.

gd: A bheil thu a' tuigsinn?
en: Do you understand?

gd: Chan eil mi a' tuigsinn.
en: I don't understand.

gd: Tha an t-uisge ann an-diugh.
en: It is raining today.

gd: Tha mo mhàthair glè mhath.
en: My mother is very well.

gd: Càite a bheil an taigh-bìdh?
en: Where is the restaurant?

gd: Tha mi sgìth an-dràsta.
en: I am tired right now.

gd: An toil leat cofaidh no tì?
en: Do you like coffee or tea?

gd: Bidh mi a' dol dhan sgoil a-màireach.
en: I will go to school tomorrow.

gd: Bha e brèagha an-dè.
en: It was beautiful yesterday.

gd: Chòrd am film rium gu mòr.
en: I enjoyed the film a lot.

gd: Cia mheud a tha seo a' cosg?
en: How much does this cost?

gd: An do bhruidhinn thu ris an-dè?
en: Did you speak to him yesterday?

gd: Tha an t-acras orm.
en: I am hungry.

gd: Is toil leam a bhith a' coiseachd anns na beanntan.
en: I like walking in the mountains.

gd: Tha i nas fheàrr an-diugh na an-dè.
en: She is better today than yesterday.

gd: Nam biodh an t-airgead agam, shiubhlainn timcheall an t-saoghail.
en: If I had the money, I would travel around the world.

gd: Ged a bha mi sgìth, chaidh mi dhan choinneimh co-dhiù.
en: Although I was tired, I went to the meeting anyway.

gd: Thuirt e gun robh e deiseil airson falbh.
en: He said that he was ready to leave.

gd: Chaidh an taigh ùr a thogail an-uiridh.
en: The new house was built last year.

gd: Tha an rud as cudromaiche dhomh fhìn a bhith a' faighinn deagh fhoghlam.
en: The most important thing for me is getting a good education.

gd: Feumaidh sinn beachdachadh air na builean mus dèan sinn co-dhùnadh.
en: We need to consider the outcomes before we make a decision.

gd: Dh'fhàs a' choimhearsnachd nas làidire thar nam bliadhnaichean.
en: The community grew stronger over the years.

gd: Tha dùbhlain mhòra romhainn a thaobh na h-àrainneachd.
en: We have major challenges ahead regarding the environment.

gd: Air an làimh eile, feumar cuimhneachadh air na buannachdan a thig leis an atharrachadh seo.
en: On the other hand, one must remember the advantages that come with this change.

gd: Thathar ag ràdh gum bi am poileasaidh ùr ga bhuileachadh ron ath-bhliadhna.
en: It is being said that the new policy will be implemented before next year.

gd: A rèir choltais, tha a' mhòr-chuid den phoball an aghaidh an atharrachaidh.
en: Apparently, the majority of the public are against the change.

gd: Aig a' cheann thall, is e an fhianais as làidire a bhios a' toirt buaidh air a' cho-dhùnadh.
en: Ultimately, it's the strongest evidence that will influence the decision.

gd: Tha connspaid mhòr air a bhith ann mun reachdas ùr a thaobh na h-àrainneachd.
en: There has been major controversy over the new environmental legislation.

gd: Gu h-àraidh am measg dhaoine òga, tha teicneòlas air buaidh mhòr a thoirt air mar a tha sinn a' conaltradh.
en: Particularly among young people, technology has had a big effect on how we communicate.
